load_screen.mating_source: PS-43045-001 revision R,6.2 item7:8.0 N/circuit maximum;12 circuits
load_screen.mating_motion: Fixed receptacle moves -Y toward the supported module plug.
load_screen.bolt_reaction_basis: Static two-point force balance; no assumed friction/preload credit.
load_screen.material: PA6-CF candidate; no measured directional/moisture/creep allowable assigned
limits: Actual flange contact, load sharing, bolt/printed-bearing stresses and joint stiffness remain unmodelled.
No stress concentration, panel clip stress, screw preload, nut-seat creep, print porosity or fatigue calculation.
The torsion approximation is a screening estimate, not a guaranteed conservative stress bound.
Use conditioned printed material evidence and a complete load/contact model before acceptance.

assembly_order.note: Bare carrier, before connectors/electronics. Heat-setting process still requires coupon measurements.
Hold nuts from the inward face until screws engage; screws and nuts remain with module.
Snap-panel flex/retention unresolved; rigid supplier intersection is recorded, not waived.
PCB prevents straight nut removal after installation; remove PCB first to replace bracket.

unmodelled_retained_items: Twelve C3 male contacts and installed crimps
Four C2 signal male contacts and installed crimps
C2 power connector contacts/terminations and retained power tails
C2/C3 signal wiring, external BUS and return junctions, ties and abrasion protection
Pan-servo carrier-side connector, support and retained lead
New protection circuit, thermal solution and real board terminals
limits: Not a full insertion/removal sequence or upper-head-motion check.
Panel snap flex, thread clocking, torque, strength, creep and physical fit remain unqualified.
Nut pockets resist rotation only after assembly; hold loose nuts until screws engage.
C2/C3/servo parking, actual retained tails/junctions and added protection board remain incomplete.
Wire-exit and tool corridors are explicit design reservations, not detailed cable/tool models.
public_geometry_note: Independently authored dimension representation; not manufacturer CAD; no threads or flexible clip geometry.
